title: Blygger resolution block
description: The JSON inside a fenced `resolution` block, added in a later version of the claim's item (or in another item that responds to it).

outcome.description: true or false; "void" when the criteria could not be applied.

resolved_at.description: The date the outcome became known. Defaults to the version's date.

evidence.description: URLs or citations supporting the outcome. Recommended.

reveal.description: Commit-reveal: the salt and the claim text whose sha256 matches the claim's `commit`.
